newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Hyundai wins $480 mln Malay order.
newsitem.headline: Hyundai wins $480 mln Malay order.

text.p: Hyundai Engineering and Construciton, a unit of South Korea's Hyundai Group, said on Thursday it won a $480 million power plant construction order from Ekran Bhd of Malaysia.
A Hyundai spokesman said the company would build a 205-metre-high concrete dam and install 165-km-long cables for the Bakun Water Power Plant in Malaysia's Sarawak state.
He said construction of the Bakun plant would cost a total of $5.1 billion.
Construction will begin in September and with completion by the year 2003.
Hyundai has won a total of $2.6 billion worth of construction orders from Malaysia, including the power plant order.
